title: Psalm 125
opening_line: They in the LORD that firmly trust

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: They in the LORD that firmly trust

text.diplomatic: shall be like Zion hill,
text.normalized: Shall be like Zion hill,
text.reading: shall be like Zion hill,

text.diplomatic: Which at no time can be removed,
text.normalized: Which at no time can be removed,
text.reading: Which at no time can be removed,

text.diplomatic: but standeth ever still.

text.reading: but standeth ever still.

text.diplomatic: As round about Jerusalem
text.normalized: As round about Jerusalem
text.reading: As round about Jerusalem

text.diplomatic: the mountains stand alway,
text.normalized: The mountains stand alway,
text.reading: the mountains stand alway,

text.diplomatic: The LORD his folk doth compass so,
text.normalized: The LORD his folk doth compass so,
text.reading: The LORD his folk doth compass so,

text.diplomatic: from henceforth and for aye.
text.normalized: From henceforth and for aye.
text.reading: from henceforth and for aye.

text.diplomatic: For ill men’s rod upon the lot
text.normalized: For ill men’s rod upon the lot
text.reading: For ill men’s rod upon the lot

text.diplomatic: of just men shall not lie;
text.normalized: Of just men shall not lie;
text.reading: of just men shall not lie;

text.diplomatic: Lest righteous men stretch forth their hands
text.normalized: Lest righteous men stretch forth their hands
text.reading: Lest righteous men stretch forth their hands

text.diplomatic: unto iniquity.
text.normalized: Unto iniquity.
text.reading: unto iniquity.

text.diplomatic: Do thou to all those that be good
text.normalized: Do thou to all those that be good
text.reading: Do thou to all those that be good

text.diplomatic: thy goodness, LORD, impart;
text.normalized: Thy goodness, LORD, impart;
text.reading: thy goodness, LORD, impart;

text.diplomatic: And do thou good to those that are
text.normalized: And do thou good to those that are
text.reading: And do thou good to those that are

text.diplomatic: upright within their heart.
text.normalized: Upright within their heart.
text.reading: upright within their heart.

text.diplomatic: But as for such as turn aside
text.normalized: But as for such as turn aside
text.reading: But as for such as turn aside

text.diplomatic: after their crooked way,
text.normalized: After their crooked way,
text.reading: after their crooked way,

text.diplomatic: GOD shall lead forth with wicked men:
text.normalized: GOD shall lead forth with wicked men:
text.reading: GOD shall lead forth with wicked men:

text.diplomatic: on Isr’el peace shall stay.
